ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: 'Check' icon from lucide-react was used in reasons map (line 102) but missing from import list — caused ReferenceError and triggered global ErrorBoundary on /client?tab=property, blocking entire Cartea Casei page. Added Check to lucide-react import.

action_items: None blocking — main agent should be aware that PropertyHubV2.jsx had a missing lucide-react import ('Check') that crashed the whole Cartea Casei view. Fixed in this iteration; consider adding a lint rule for undefined JSX identifiers or a smoke test for /client?tab=property that fails on ErrorBoundary render.
critical_code_review_comments: PropertyHubV2.jsx: use of ErrorBoundary hid the issue in prod-like preview — a single missing icon crashed the WHOLE Cartea Casei tree. Consider wrapping only the PVI card in its own boundary so twin/health/wallet remain usable.

value_loop.compute_pvi: warranty component queries {'until': {'$gte': _now()}} using ISO strings — works because ISO-8601 sorts lexicographically, but a mismatched timezone-less string in DB (from other writers) could subtly break. All current writers use timezone-aware ISO — OK.

routes/property_dna.py: refresh_pvi is called on GET (dna_view) — creates a write on every DNA read. High-traffic reads will bloat pvi_history. Consider caching (already stored on prop.pvi) and only re-scoring on real triggers, or throttling to once/hour.

routes/requests.py confirm_complete: enrich_on_closure runs synchronously — adds 4 mongo writes to the confirm response path. For now latency is fine, but could be moved to BackgroundTasks to keep p95 low.

opportunities.py my_opportunities: lazy scan on every GET; already throttled, but no cap on wall time — a slow scanner could time out the whole /client/opportunities response. Wrap in asyncio.wait_for.
seed_data_creation: One completed request '[TEST] Value Loop E2E iter119' inserted via Mongo on client's first property, then confirmed via API. Left as 'confirmed' in DB along with 1 warranty and 1 pvi_history row.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Value Loop E2E harness at /app/backend/tests/test_value_loop_iter119.py — re-runnable, seeds its own [TEST] request each run. After first run, client's demo property will have PVI ≈ 90/100 (twin unlocked + works/warranties/identity components populated). Cartea Casei tab requires all lucide-react icons used in JSX to be imported — Check was missing.
rca_of_the_issue: Missing named import 'Check' from lucide-react in /app/frontend/src/pages/clientv2/PropertyHubV2.jsx. The PVI reasons list rendered <Check .../> at line 102 for each of the 6 reasons; React threw ReferenceError, ErrorBoundary caught it and replaced the entire Cartea Casei with the black 'Ceva nu a mers cum trebuie' screen. Reproduction: login as client → GET /client?tab=property. Mitigation: add 'Check' to the destructured lucide-react import (fix applied).
